ops.title: Drop legacy status projections (WedgedMounts, FPWedged, TCCError) post-v0.50.0
ops.description: v0.50.0 ships Response.Ledgers + StatusSnapshot.Ledgers as the observability surface; the legacy projections were kept byte-identical for one release for widget/doctor wire compat (decision during Track B phase 5). Once the fleet's widgets and doctor binaries are >= v0.50.0, delete the projections and their producers, and re-point any remaining reader at the Ledgers block.

ops.text: projections and producers deleted; doctor and widget render from Ledgers only; wire tests updated
